name: DMD 4350
title: Advanced 3D Research and Production
description: Explores, develops and evaluates the research and skills in 3D animation production, focusing on each student's own path of study. May be repeated for a total of 9 credits.
requirement_description: DMD 3310; open to B.F.A Digital Media and Design 3D Animation concentration students only, others by instructor consent. Recommended preparation: DMD 3300, 3350, 4310 and 4340.
